changes.text: Report a chat message: hover over it (or tap ⋯ on your phone), choose Report message and tell us what's wrong. An admin reviews every report.
Announcements: when there's something everyone should know, it shows in a bar under the header on every page, without a refresh. Dismiss it and it stays gone until the next one.
If an admin suspends your account, a notice at the top of every page says why and until when. You can still sign in and look around, but trading, posting, chat and games are off until it ends.
If you're muted or banned in chat, the message box now says so and until when.
